role.zh: 数据运营 - 项目管理

body.en: Led **6 AI data annotation projects** (assisting on **3 more**), handling **~700K** data items across **10+** languages and multimodal formats (text, video, images). Scenarios spanned **AIGC generation** and **ad targeting driven by content understanding**, supporting model training and business delivery.
body.zh: 主导 **6 个** AI 数据标注项目（另辅助 **3 个**），累计处理 **约 70 万条** 数据条目，覆盖 **10+ 种语言** 及文本、视频、图片等多模态格式。项目场景涵盖 **AIGC 生成** 与 **基于内容理解的广告投放**，支撑多场景下的模型训练与业务落地。

body.en: Aligned requirements with product and algorithm teams, breaking down priorities. Designed **5 annotation SOPs**, **10+ templates** and **3 workflow types**, building a **reusable data production pipeline**. Coordinated international annotation team resources to keep projects running efficiently.
body.zh: 与产品、算法团队对齐需求并拆解优先级。设计 **5 套标注 SOP**、**10+ 套标注模板** 与 **3 类工作流**，搭建起 **可复用的数据生产流程**。协调国际标注团队资源，保障项目高效推进。

body.en: Built a progress dashboard on a **BI platform** to continuously track task progress, with alerts and regular reviews for overdue and quality risks. For any schedule deviation, adjusted resources and processes in time to achieve a **95% on-time delivery rate**.
body.zh: 在 **BI 平台** 上搭建进度看板，持续跟踪任务进度，对逾期与质量风险设置预警并定期排查。一旦出现进度偏离，及时调整资源与流程，最终达成 **95% 按期交付率**。

body.en: Built QA evaluation across **three levels** — annotation quality, model effectiveness, and production readiness. By diagnosing **Bad Cases** and feeding findings back to refine the annotation standard, boosted data accuracy by **up to 15%** and model recall by **up to 5%**, keeping models stable in production and improving user satisfaction.
body.zh: 从 **三个层面** 建立质检评估——标注质量、模型效果、上线可用性。通过对 **Bad Case** 做拆解归因，并将结论反哺到标注标准迭代，推动数据准确率最大提升 **15%**、模型召回率最大提升 **5%**，保障模型上线稳定，用户满意度同步提升。

body.en: Built **ETL pipelines** using **SQL and Python on Hive**. On a **low-code platform**, built **two agents** — an annotation agent to pre-annotate rule-based items, and a QA agent to auto-sample, review, and feed Bad Cases back into the standard. Completed **~50K auto-annotations**, achieving **~90% QA accuracy** and scalable data production.
body.zh: 基于 **Hive 数仓**，用 **SQL 与 Python** 编写 **ETL 脚本** 完成数据抽取、清洗与加载。在 **低代码平台** 上搭建 **两个 Agent**——标注 Agent 对规则明确的条目做机器预标注，QA Agent 自动抽样质检、并将 Bad Case 回流至标注标准。累计完成 **约 5 万条** 自动标注，质检准确率约 **90%**，实现 **规模化数据生产**。

title.en: Chinese Stock-Comment Sentiment Recognition with Qwen-4B & LoRA
title.zh: 基于 Qwen-4B 与 LoRA 微调的中文股票评论情感识别研究

body.en: Social-media stock comments suffer from short texts, implicit expressions, and mixed jargon, severely limiting sentiment recognition and creating a "breakpoint" from text to signal that struggles to serve quantitative investing.
body.zh: 社交媒体股票评论存在短文本、隐晦表达、专业术语混杂等问题，严重制约情感识别的有效性，成为从文本到信号的"断点"，难以服务于量化投资。

body.en: Integrated Tianchi labeled data, East Money Guba scraped data (~218K comments), and SSE 50 historical market data.
body.zh: 整合天池标注数据、东方财富股吧爬取数据（约 21.8 万条评论）及上证 50 历史行情数据。

body.en: Built a six-stage progressive comparison framework from traditional to pretrained to Qwen-4B LLMs, using Macro-F1 as the core metric to systematically evaluate cross-generation performance; applied LoRA fine-tuning for targeted optimization. The best model reached Macro-F1 0.86, +11.7% over BERT (0.77), and 0.81 even zero-shot — validating efficiency and generalizability.
body.zh: 构建从传统模型到预训练模型、再到 Qwen-4B 大模型的六阶段递进式对比框架，以 Macro-F1 为核心指标系统性评估不同代际技术的性能；并通过 LoRA 微调实现定向优化。最优模型 Macro-F1 达 0.86，较 BERT（0.77）提升 11.7%，零样本下亦达 0.81，验证了模型的高效性与泛化能力。

body.en: Using the best model to predict SSE 50 comment sentiment for 2024–2025, constructed 20+ proxy variables and synthesized a sentiment factor via PCA. Finding: sentiment volatility correlates with ATR_pct at -0.89, and the put/call ratio leads volatility by 2 months (r=0.81) — confirming the strong correlation and lead relationship between sentiment signals and market volatility.
body.zh: 基于最优模型预测 2024–2025 年上证 50 评论情感，构建情绪强度、分歧度等 20 余个代理变量，并利用 PCA 合成情绪因子。分析发现：情绪波动率与 ATR_pct 相关系数为 -0.89，认沽认购比率领先波动率 2 个月（相关系数 0.81），验证了情绪信号与市场波动之间的强相关性及领先关系。

title.zh: 杭州市交通优化方案设计 AI 智能体项目

body.en: As a pioneer in digital governance, Hangzhou has built a traffic platform, yet weekday rush-hour congestion index often exceeds 2.5, parking gap reaches 35%, and public transit faces >120% peak load and unreasonable intervals — traditional management is trapped in being "data-rich but insight-poor."
body.zh: 杭州作为数字化治理先行城市，虽已搭建交通治理平台，但工作日早晚高峰拥堵指数常超 2.5，停车位缺口达 35%，公共交通也存在高峰满载率超过 120%、发车间隔不合理等问题，传统管理手段陷入"数据过载却洞察不足"的困境。

body.en: Collected 326K+ records of Hangzhou traffic congestion, accidents, and flow; scraped Zhihu and surveyed 2,000+ citizen-feedback entries; collected Hangzhou POI geo-data.
body.zh: 采集 32.6 万+ 条杭州市交通拥堵、事故、流量数据；爬取知乎并发放问卷获取 2000+ 条市民反馈数据；采集杭州市 POI 地理信息数据。

body.en: Used GIS spatial analysis to identify congestion/accident hotspots and extract spatiotemporal features; LDA to identify citizens' core needs; sentiment analysis to extract emotional features from citizen text.
body.zh: 采用 GIS 空间分析识别交通拥堵与事故热点区域，提取时间与空间特征；采用 LDA 模型识别市民反馈的核心需求；采用情感分析方法提取市民文本的情感特征。

body.en: Wrote LLM prompts to convert findings into 100+ dialogue-flow datasets, built a status-assessment knowledge base and workflow, optimized component config, and tuned model performance from feedback.
body.zh: 撰写大模型 prompt，将分析结论转换为 100+ 条对话流数据集，搭建现状评估知识库与工作流，优化组件配置，并根据用户反馈对模型性能进行调优。

body.en: From historical traffic and complaint-text analysis, the AI agent identified 3 typical congestion patterns via spatiotemporal extraction; the plan projects +22.3% morning-peak efficiency and quantifies citizens' core demands via LDA. Drew 15+ charts to visualize conclusions (congestion geo-heatmap, congestion-index-over-time trends, etc.).
body.zh: 基于杭州市交通的历史路况数据与市民投诉文本分析，AI 智能体通过时空特征提取成功识别出 3 类典型拥堵模式，方案预期实现早高峰通行效率提升 22.3%，并依据 LDA 主题模型量化出市民核心诉求；绘制 15 张+ 可视化图形直观展示分析结论（拥堵地理热点图、拥堵指数随时间变化趋势图等）。

title.zh: AutoPrice · 二手车价格预测项目

body.en: Traditional manual used-car appraisal averages 12% error — 67% of dealers lose >¥80K/month from mispricing, and buyers' decision time stretches from 7 to 21 days. A data-driven precise pricing model is urgently needed.
body.zh: 传统二手车人工评估模式平均误差可达车价的 12%——一方面 67% 的车商因定价偏差月均亏损超过 8 万元，另一方面消费者的平均购车决策时间从 7 天延长至 21 天。因此，亟需构建数据驱动的精准二手车价格预测模型。

body.en: Collected 150K+ used-car records; mode imputation for categorical missing values, truncation for outliers, Z-score standardization and log transform on target to improve quality. Built 28 new features via 5 methods (time deltas, binning, cross features) to capture trends, nonlinearity, categorical info; then variance filtering, correlation analysis, Lasso (linear dim reduction) and Random Forest (nonlinear contribution) kept 14 key features.
body.zh: 采集 15 万+ 条二手车数据；对分类型缺失值做众数填充，对异常值做截断修正，并使用 Z-score 标准化与目标列对数变换提升数据质量。通过时间差值、分箱、交叉等 5 种方法构造 28 个新特征，以捕捉时序趋势、非线性关系及类别信息；再结合方差筛选、相关性分析、Lasso（线性降维）与随机森林（非线性贡献评估），最终保留 14 个关键特征。

body.en: Drew 6 charts analyzing price drivers, brand retention, and regional traits; parsed how base attributes relate to price and how brand/region/age affect value.
body.zh: 绘制 6 张图表分析二手车市场价格影响因素、品牌保值率及区域特征，解析基础属性与价格的关联，以及品牌、区域、车龄对价值的影响。

body.en: Compared Linear Regression, DNN, ExtraTrees, and LightGBM; used Optuna Bayesian optimization + cross-validation for best params; deeper analysis on predictive performance, generalization, and key factors.
body.zh: 研究对比线性回归、DNN、极端随机树与 LightGBM 模型，并结合 Optuna 贝叶斯优化策略与交叉验证方法获取模型最优参数组合，进一步从预测性能、泛化能力、关键因素三方面进行深入分析。

body.en: Designed 6 mini-program UI pages, built a working used-car pricing mini-program prototype, interviewed 1 used-car company, and signed 2 long-term LOIs with 2 Xi'an used-car companies.
body.zh: 设计 6 个小程序 UI 页面，完成二手车价格预测小程序样品；对 1 家二手车公司进行访谈，与西安 2 家二手车公司签订 2 份长期合作意向协议。

body.en: Delivered a 30K+-word report; LightGBM excelled — test MSE 0.0551, RMSE 0.2347, MAE 0.1233, MAPE 1.65%, R² 0.963; MAPE shows 3–6× better pricing accuracy vs industry average, with train/test error converging by 1,000 epochs and a stable learning curve (no overfit), proving robustness.
body.zh: 完成 3 万+ 字论文报告；LightGBM 模型预测精度显著优秀，测试集上 MSE 为 0.0551、RMSE 为 0.2347、MAE 为 0.1233、MAPE 为 1.65%、决定系数达 0.963；其中 MAPE 指标显示定价精度较行业平均提升 3–6 倍，且训练集与测试集误差差异在 1000 轮迭代时趋近于 0、学习曲线平稳，未过拟合，证明其稳健性优异。
